History lives in logs/decisions.md and the per-run directories; the human view of THIS file is logs/STATE.md and the two must agree. README owns no live facts. Ownership rules: logs/CATALOG.md.
baseline_commit_meaning: The LAST TESTED IMPLEMENTATION: the commit whose tree produced the latest_verification figures. It is deliberately NOT always the commit carrying this file -- when a paid launch is prepared, a grant/provenance commit and an authorization-only commit follow it and neither is separately tested. A reader must be able to tell which commit the suite numbers describe from which commit a pod checks out. Nothing checks this field; it is refreshed by hand whenever the verified tree moves.
